hero.title:
Your operation,

in your hand.
hero.body: Growcast connects a physical operation to your phone, tablet or PC. It measures, records, analyses, alerts and can act on the operation.
sensors.title: Sensors at the critical points.
sensors.body: Temperature, humidity, CO₂, electrical conductivity, pH, pressure, equipment status: each industry needs to measure different variables.
data.title: Data becomes a tool.
data.body: Current conditions, historical charts, trends, indicators, alerts and custom data analysis, all in one place.
converge.title: It all converges in Growcast.
converge.body: When the installation allows it, Growcast operates equipment automatically or remotely. Everything is recorded: measurements, alerts, equipment status and events.

sol.cultivo.title: Every room, on one platform.
sol.cultivo.lede: Temperature, humidity, CO₂, ventilation, irrigation, substrate, water and nutrition change constantly. Small deviations sustained over time can affect quality, productivity, plant health or efficiency.

sol.silos.title: Every silo, in your own hand.
sol.silos.lede: Temperature, humidity, CO₂, outdoor conditions and the use of aeration directly affect the quality of the stored product and energy consumption.
sol.silos.impl.3: Remote or automatic operation, according to the defined operating strategy.
sol.silos.impl.4: A record of when, how long and under what conditions aeration was used.
sol.silos.solve.1: No continuous monitoring inside the silos.
sol.silos.solve.2: Aeration run manually or without records.
sol.silos.solve.3: Unnecessary energy use for lack of information.
sol.silos.solve.4: Late detection of critical or extreme conditions.

sol.maduracion.title: Every cycle, recorded.
sol.maduracion.lede: In cheese, cured meats and other ripened foods, the conditions accumulated during the process can matter as much as the recipe or the raw material.
sol.maduracion.impl.4: Other environmental equipment, depending on the installation.
sol.maduracion.solve.4: No evidence to analyse what happened during a process.

contact.title: Let's talk about your operation.
contact.body: Is there an important process that today is handled by eye, without data? Every implementation starts by understanding the operation.
solutions.title: One technology base, different operations.
solutions.body: Solutions change by industry, but the logic is always the same: measure an important variable, record what happens, interpret the information and, when possible, control the equipment.
sol.step.1.title: We measure
sol.step.2.title: We analyse and alert
sol.step.3.title: We control and record
sol.cultivo.who: Fruit and vegetables, mushrooms, hydroponics, ornamental flowers, nurseries, plant breeding, biotechnological processes and controlled-environment rooms.
sol.cultivo.step.1: We install sensors in each room, greenhouse or sector, at the points that matter for your process.
sol.cultivo.step.2: See every space on one platform: detect deviations in real time, receive alerts and compare environments.
sol.cultivo.step.3: Growcast builds historical records per cycle, room or batch and, when the installation allows it, automates repetitive tasks.
sol.silos.who: Grain storage facilities, feed mills, seed companies, flour mills, grain conditioning plants and malt houses.
sol.silos.step.1: We install sensors in each silo: inside temperature, relative humidity and CO₂, together with outside conditions.
sol.silos.step.2: Growcast centralises each silo's information: current conditions, history, alerts and comparison between silos.
sol.silos.step.3: When the system is integrated with aeration, the fans can be operated remotely or automatically according to the defined operating strategy, with a record of when, how long and under what conditions they ran.
sol.maduracion.who: Cheese ripening rooms, cured-meat drying rooms, ripening and storage chambers, and warehouses with critical environmental conditions.
sol.maduracion.step.1: We install sensors in each room, chamber or drying room.
sol.maduracion.step.2: See conditions in real time, receive alerts on deviations and compare ripening or drying cycles.
sol.maduracion.step.3: We record how conditions evolve for each batch and, when the installation allows it, integrate with the environmental control equipment.
silo.aria: Diagram: the sensors inside the silo and a CO₂ sensor send their readings to the Growcast control board, which operates the aeration fan; everything is visible in real time on your phone.
grow.aria: Diagram: the room sensors send temperature, humidity, CO₂, EC and pH to the Growcast control board, which operates lights, ventilation and irrigation; everything is visible in real time on your phone.
cure.aria: Diagram: the ripening-room sensors send temperature, humidity and CO₂ to the Growcast control board, which operates cooling and the humidifier; everything is visible in real time on your phone.
